=== CONTROL: the same test against a NON-atomic implementation ===
    (GET then INCR as two round trips — the pattern AGENTS.md 2.2 forbids)
    NON-ATOMIC (GET then INCR): 1000 allowed, want exactly 100
    => over limit by 900: the test WOULD catch this

    The control confirms this test can detect a race: the non-atomic
    version admits 1000 of 1000 against a limit of 100, because every
    goroutine reads the counter before any increment lands.
